summary: Kite Realty Group, L.P. filed an 8-K announcing an offering of $300 million aggregate principal amount of exchangeable senior notes due 2032 in a private placement to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A. The notes are exchangeable into cash up to principal and, if applicable, cash or common shares. The issuer expects to enter into capped call transactions with option counterparties. This is a financing event rather than an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. No specific price per share, premium, or other terms were disclosed.
